note: Don Pedro Recreation Agency (Turlock and Modesto Irrigation Districts) campground where the Moccasin Creek arm meets Don Pedro Lake, off CA-120 near Jamestown. The 18 full-hookup sites (A area and B-22 to B-27) are the only ones a 23-ft rig fits; the 78 B-E area sites are tent sites with car-length parking. Boat ramp, marina and fish-cleaning station. --Claude
summary: Agency page + 2026 fee schedule + campground map + reservation engine (site list with coordinates/lengths) + 3DEP + imagery read. 18 FHU 30A sites at $60 ($15 reservation fee), tents $40; 2-night minimum, 14-night max, booked a year out on the agency's own engine; showers, dump; year-round. Waterfront DOWN: the lakefront tent sites can't take a rig and the hookup loop is 150+ m from and 20+ m above full pool under canopy. max_rig 42 cleared. Phone empty -> 209-852-2396.
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront -> lakeview RECOMMENDED (default-down; not waterfront if the canopy rules out a view): the sites on the High Water Mark (map D-Area 6-11, E-Area 3-8; 3DEP 251-255 m vs the 253 m / 830 ft full pool, e.g. D-7 at 37.82506,-120.33100 and E-7 at 37.82384,-120.32774) are all 'Site Type: Tent' with 'Parking Length' 4-17 ft - not usable by a 23-ft rig.
